Auto panel rebuilt against the frame. Field label is now the frame's "Number of Bets:" (was "Number of bets"), the value accepts 0, and an infinity affordance sits at the field's trailing edge exactly where the frame puts its 16x7 boolean-op glyph - rendered with the lucide Infinity icon re-exported by @skai/ui/icons, aliased InfinityIcon so it cannot shadow the global Infinity used by the burst rail. 0 now genuinely means UNLIMITED: burstDrop takes total = POSITIVE_INFINITY and the staggered interval never retires itself, placing one REAL playPlinko settlement per ball until the player stops it or dropBall tears the run down for a real reason (balance, validator, rate limit). Previously the field clamped 1..25 with no unlimited state at all. The 25-ball cap is now correctly treated as a RENDER budget, not a bet cap: a run longer than the cap WAITS for headroom on each tick instead of being trimmed, so the "Burst Trimmed" toast is gone. CTA relabelled to the frame's "Bet" (was "Start Autobet"/"Start Autobet (N)"). THREE DELIBERATE DEVIATIONS, all reported: (1) the CTA shows "Stop" while an Auto run is queueing - the frame draws no stop state and an unlimited autobet cannot ship without one; Space/Enter mirrors it. (2) Auto still defaults to 1 bet, not the frame's drawn 0 - the frame's 0 is a placeholder in the same class as its "100" bet amount and "100.11 SKAI" balance (the code defaults the bet to 0.10, not 100), and defaulting a real-money autobet to unlimited is not a default anyone chose; the infinity affordance is one tap away. (3) the POINTS/SKAI/sUSD currency row is not in the frame, which draws a single SKAI field - it is retained because the panel is the only place to pick the settlement rail. Not render-verified.

MOBILE 375 PAGE (mis-titled 'Dice Mobile' in Figma; it is Plinko, 375x1605) - BUILT AND CLOSED 2026-08-05. This frame's recorded gap was 'the mobile CTA-above-fields inversion is unbuilt'. It is now built, and building it surfaced a P0 nobody had recorded. ★ DEFECT 1 - PLINKO WAS UNPLAYABLE ON A PHONE. PlinkoGame's widget body was `flex flex-row` at EVERY width while the bet panel is `shrink-0` at up to 356px, so at 375 the game area was left ~19px and, after its own px-4, the canvas measured 0px WIDE - measured, not inferred: cssW 0, parent 32px. A player on a phone saw no board at all. This is the identical bug DiceGame had already fixed; Plinko never got the same fix. Now `flex flex-col lg:flex-row`, board `order-1 lg:order-2` above panel `order-2 lg:order-1`, the 356px cap and the divider border made lg-only, and the route's 720px height cap made lg-only so the stacked layout is not clipped by `overflow-hidden`. ★ DEFECT 2 - THE CANVAS NEVER RE-MEASURED. `setCanvasRef` is a ref callback: it fired once at mount and pinned the canvas to whatever the slot measured then, so the board was frozen for the life of the component - rotate a phone or drag a window and the geometry never followed. Worse, it overwrites `node.width`, which IS the element's intrinsic size, so a canvas that had once shrunk could only ever shrink further. Fixed by measuring the SLOT's CONTENT BOX (clientWidth/clientHeight INCLUDE the slot's px-4, and fitting against them over-measured by 32px, let flex-shrink claw back only the width, and rendered the board at a 1.09 aspect instead of its 1.2 - so the padding is subtracted explicitly), fitting the largest 600x500-aspect box that fits, capping at the design size, and re-running it from a ResizeObserver. The observer is gated on NO balls in flight, because ball paths are generated in canvas coordinates at drop time and resizing the backing store mid-flight would move a live bet's ball off its own path. ★ ORDER, read off the frame rather than assumed: the mobile panel 9137:12151 orders its children CTA (9137:12152, y=12) -> bet amount + balance (9178:9330, y=80) -> risk (9137:12184, y=186) -> rows (9137:12200, y=266) -> Manual|Auto (9137:12209, y=348), and the panel itself sits at y=355 with the board above it. Reproduced and MEASURED at WIDTH=375: board 305x254 (ratio 1.201) at y=227, CTA 597, Bet amount 725, Balance 839, Difficulty 885, Rows 969, Manual|Auto LAST at 1029. Round trip 1440->375->768->1440 re-measured live: 600x500 -> 305x254 -> 379x316 -> 600x500, every one at the 1.2 aspect, 0px overflow and exactly one CTA throughout. The frame's 'Risk: Low/Medium/High' segment is still deliberately not reproduced (retired vocabulary).
